vulnerabilities.weakness: Stateful cache with emptyDir and no PVC, single replica, no PDB – data loss and cart unavailability on pod restart
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the redis-cart pod is terminated, then cart data is lost and subsequent checkout requests fail

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single‑replica entrypoint with no PDB or HPA, so a pod failure or overload can bring the entire site down
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the frontend pod crashes or is killed, then all user requests fail and the site becomes unavailable

vulnerabilities.weakness: Central orchestrator of checkout path, single replica, no PDB – failure stalls entire checkout flow
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the checkoutservice pod dies, then all checkout requests time out and orders cannot be placed

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica, no PDB – catalog lookup failures can degrade product browsing and recommendation
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the productcatalogservice pod is terminated, then product pages and recommendations fail to load

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica with no PDB – cart retrieval may fail during pod restart, degrading checkout experience
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the cartservice pod is killed, then cart data cannot be fetched and checkout stalls

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica, no PDB – currency conversion failures can delay checkout
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the currencyservice pod is killed, then checkout stalls waiting for conversion

vulnerabilities.weakness: Optional advertising service; failure should not impact core checkout flow
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the adservice pod is killed, then ads stop showing but checkout proceeds normally

vulnerabilities.weakness: Non‑critical recommendation; failure should degrade but not block checkout
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the recommendationservice pod is terminated, then recommendations are missing but checkout continues

systemic: All services lack PDB and HPA, exposing the cluster to single‑point failures and traffic spikes.
